svg.aria-label: Browser-bind machine: a framed browser window (left) is bound by name to a session drum (centre) — pull the lit orange lever to bind the live, logged-in browser — and an n8n agent connects through the MCP plug on the right (@playwright/mcp). The dial shows bound sessions; the film reel is the screencast receipt. Verified numbers: Playwright 1.65 shipped November 5, 2026 with 8 breaking changes and Chromium 158; browser.bind() shipped in 1.59.
